label: No placebo
rationale: This is an open-label, randomized pilot trial in which participants receive one of four individualized supplements, with no placebo arm described. The record explicitly says participants are their own controls and that after classification they receive 1 of 4 treatments, which supports an active-treatment-only design rather than placebo comparison.

participants in this study will receive one of four individualized supplements

title: ROAR-DIGAP: A Widely Inclusive, Largely Virtual Pilot Trial Utilizing DIGAP (Deep Integrated Genomics Analysis Platform) To Personalize Treatments
